# meshopt SIMD fixtures

Real files, compressed by gltfpack 1.3.0 (npm package `gltfpack`, MIT), run outside this repository.

- `knight-ext.glb`: the KayKit Adventurers knight from `examples/assets/kaykit` (Kay Lousberg, CC0), `gltfpack -cc`, so
  `EXT_meshopt_compression` with attribute codec version 0.
- `knight-khr.glb`: the same model written with `KHR_meshopt_compression`, attribute codec version 1.
